name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add tomato sauce. Simmer and serve over pasta.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add chicken and curry powder. Stir in coconut milk. Simmer until chicken is cooked.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Heat oil. Add garlic and vegetables. Stir fry until tender. Add soy sauce and serve.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef. Add vegetables and stock. Simmer until beef is tender.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread. Place cheese between slices. Grill until golden brown.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Pour batter onto hot pan. Flip when bubbles form.

name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Toss lettuce with dressing. Add croutons and parmesan.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and stock. Blend until smooth.

name: Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs with milk. Pour into pan. Add cheese. Fold and serve.

name: Roast Chicken
instructions: Season chicken. Stuff with garlic and lemon. Roast until golden.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes. Mash with butter and milk. Season with salt.

name: French Toast
instructions: Mix eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon. Dip bread. Fry until golden.

name: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice. Scramble eggs. Stir fry with vegetables and soy sauce.

name: Lasagna
instructions: Layer sheets with beef, sauce, and cheese. Bake until golden.

name: Pizza Margherita
instructions: Spread sauce on dough. Add cheese and basil. Bake until crisp.

name: Chicken Soup
instructions: Cook chicken with vegetables and stock. Simmer until tender.

name: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with other ingredients. Bake until golden.

name: Tacos
instructions: Cook beef. Fill shells with beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

name: Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Beat eggs with milk. Cook in butter. Stir until fluffy.

name: Grilled Salmon
instructions: Season salmon. Grill with lemon slices until cooked.

name: Minestrone Soup
instructions: Cook vegetables and beans in stock. Add pasta. Simmer until tender.

name: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Stuff peppers with rice and beef. Top with sauce. Bake until tender.

name: Apple Pie
instructions: Fill crust with apples, sugar, cinnamon. Bake until golden.

name: Chocolate Cake
instructions: Mix ingredients. Pour into tin. Bake until cooked through.
